items.briefing:
A new report from Arctic Wolf finds that small and medium businesses across Australia and New Zealand are rapidly adopting AI tools, but many staff don't fully trust them — which can lead to inconsistent or risky use. This is a reminder that deploying AI without clear workplace guidelines can create security gaps, even when the technology itself is sound.

For everyday staff, the key takeaway is simple: if your organisation uses AI tools, make sure you know what data you're allowed to put into them. Avoid entering sensitive student or personal information into AI platforms unless your organisation has explicitly approved it.

featured.title: ANZ SMEs adopt AI widely, but trust lags, Arctic Wolf report finds
featured.quote: Australian SMEs adopt AI but lack trust, highlighting critical cybersecurity gaps in local businesses.
